content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | Southern Petrochemicals Industries Corporation Limited (NSE: SPIC) Southern Petrochemicals Reports H1 FY27 Revenue at ₹1,847.98 Crore and PBT at ₹88.35 Crore ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - H1 FY27 Revenue from Operations: ₹1,847.98 Crore - H1 FY27 Profit Before Tax (PBT): ₹88.35 Crore - Q2 FY27 Income: ₹1,002.74 Crore - Q2 FY27 Profit: ₹45.63 Crore 📌 What happened: ↳ Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation Ltd announced its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, posting an operational revenue of ₹1,847.98 crore for the six-month period. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
